propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Semper nos, Domine, Martyrum tuorum Nerei, Achillei, Domitillae atque
Pancratii foveat, quaesumus, beata solemnitas: et tuo dignos reddat
obsequio. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: Let the blessed solemnity of Thy martyrs, Nereus, Achilleus, Domitilla, and Pancras, ever comfort us, we beseech Thee, O Lord, and render us worthy of Thy service. Through our Lord.

The existing C9 source regime fact qualifies the two source conditions; an unknown regime remains an unresolved alternative, without date inference.
